topic: A person's car is towed from their own driveway
text: You step into my office, dripping wet from the rain, looking like you've seen a ghost. "My car's gone," you say, voice tight. "From my driveway. Just... vanished." I nod, lighting a cigarette. "Guess we got ourselves a mystery," I say, blowing out a slow stream of smoke. "When was the last time you saw it parked there?" You shift in your seat, fumbling with the brim of your hat. "This morning. It was supposed to be there all day." I lean back, studying the rain-dotted window. "Towed, maybe? Fence too low, neighbor complaint?" You shake your head, too quick. "Never happened before. Nobody likes me, but nobody hates me that much." I tap my fingers on the armrest. "Let's take a walk, see what the neighbors have to say. Sometimes the truth is just around the corner, hidden in plain sight."
